headword: {菅原道真|すがわらのみちざね}
gloss: Sugawara no Michizane (scholar deified as god of learning)

definitions.explanation: A Heian-period scholar, poet and statesman who rose to high office, was exiled to Dazaifu in Kyushu after a court intrigue, and died there. Disasters in the capital after his death were blamed on his angry spirit, and he was deified as Tenjin, now worshipped as the god of learning.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
- Worshipped as {天神|てんじん}さま at {天満宮|てんまんぐう} shrines across Japan, chief among them {太宰府天満宮|だざいふてんまんぐう} and {北野天満宮|きたのてんまんぐう}
- Students visit these shrines before entrance exams and leave ⟦{絵馬|えま}→絵馬：05957_ema⟧ (votive plaques) with their wishes
- He loved plum trees; legend says his favorite plum flew from Kyoto to Dazaifu to join him ({飛梅|とびうめ}), and plum trees are planted at Tenmangū shrines
